record.question: The most common cause of acidity in water is -
record.explanation: Dissolved carbon dioxide reacts with water to form weak carbonic acid, a common natural source of water acidity. Oxygen and nitrogen do not produce that acid in the stated ordinary setting. Reference: https://pubs.usgs.gov/gip/acidrain/2.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
